chapter: Newark and first years in Harlem
title: A composer's band, Cyril Hunt and Louis Bacon, and Caribbean dance gigs
summary: Butler joined a friend's band with Cyril Hunt and Louis Bacon, played first trumpet, then gigged around including the Caribbean dances at the Renaissance for Happy Andrade.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: -- so we became great friends. He was a composer, a complete musician, saxophone player, clarinet, __________. Well, I got a job with his band. I didn't stay long because of (unintelligible). There was a boy working in his band named Cyril Hunt (PHONETIC), great trumpet, and another good friend of mine, Louis Bacon from Chicago.

Well, I stayed in this band. I was ready and I could read, ready to go. So I played first trumpet. Wasn't no time before I was getting off) and I decided I couldn't read too much first horn playing, but that's what was happening to me. Then I gigged around, gigged around. There was another man named Happy (PHONETIC), this man was att--/Andrade. He was at the -- the place was called -- it was on 139th Street, it was where all the Caribbean people give their dances -- the Renaissance. I played gigs with him. When (Louis) Metcalfe wasn't there.
